correctness.rationale: In characteristic five, substitution X=(t+a,t+b,t+c,t-a-b-c,t) transforms the three homogeneous power sums exactly into the ideal (Q,P), with Q=a²+b²+c²+ab+ac+bc and P=(a+b)(a+c)(b+c). Each cubic factor meets the conic transversely at two rational points, and Bezout's degree six rules out hidden geometric components; hence the cone has exactly six reduced lines through one vertex. The S5 stabilizer has order 20, giving six components. Hilbert series (1-z²)(1-z³)/(1-z)³ gives evaluation ranks 1,3,5,6; transitive symmetry excludes branch delta functions before degree three, proving normalization defect 9 and conductor m³. The complete intersection and nonzerodivisor 5 prove Z5 flatness. Independently generated F5 evaluation ranks and all six directions agree; these finite tests are supplemental to the algebraic proof.
